items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: How about Sophie Tucker and W.C. Fields, were they in there?

ctx.x: I guess in the middle of the year. Me and my mother went to do “Sensations of ‘45” with Cab Calloway, Eleanor Powell, Woody Herman, and Dennis O’Keefe.
How about Sophie Tucker and W.C. Fields, were they in there?
Yes, and I was in a circus.
